column1: Provide a detailed description of the proposed solution.
What are the scalability options for the proposed solution?
Scalability - min and max capacity and number of objects supported

No SPOF (Single Point of Failure) components – for software defined, how does your software report and manage failed components? Are there any SPOF in any piece of the architecture - hardware, software, or both? If no, please explain how this is accomplished.
Does the solution have automatic failure notification via email, text, and other methods?
Can access to reporting features be segregated by users/roles? If so, please explain.
Does the solution have reporting related to system health? If so, please explain the reporting and the granularity.
Product reporting - including chargeback for tenant capacity, performance usage and product health
Describe all the security features of the proposed solution.
Please specify how data at rest encryption is provided (e.g. underlying server/disk encryption, software-based server-side encryption, client provided Keys?)
Does the solution support FIPS 140-2 compliant AES 256-bit encryption? Is this compliance selectable or does it demand all or nothing?
Product performance capabilities - e.g.  read or written per minute. How many connections can the product sustain
Availability and Reliability (Resilience)
Load balancing customer IO capabilities across nodes in a cluster or across geographic areas within a region
Replication capabilities between datacentres / data protection against data loss and corruption
Compression and deduplication capabilities
TCP / Application Protocol Support
RESTful API integration for product management
Can reports be produced via REST API or viewed on a GUI - based on node/site and global capacity (total, quota, used, free)? If so, please explain what is available to see and provide sample reports.
Administration capabilities for a multi-tenant product / solution
Product monitoring capabilities - device performance, user experience and storage capacity; over which protocols and interfaces
Ability to set and apply archive quotas per tenant
Data Tiering Capability, including cloud storage endpoints / Hybrid solution
Cloud Interoperability with main stream Cloud hyperscaler

While there is no requirement for the solution to fit with a private cloud infrastructure, this is a chance for the proponent to showcase its product’s features, it will be used to ensure that the products fit well into company's future direction.
